newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end steady as Fed meets on rates.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end steady as Fed meets on rates.

text.p: South African shares ended steady in hushed cautious trade as the United States' Federal Open Market Committee met to decide on a possible interest hike.
Dealers said the gold price, trading above $351 per ounce, rekindled limited interest in golds in afternoon trade, but the golds index ended flat.
Some institutional buying of select stocks was seen at lower levels. Volumes were moderate at 613 million rand worth.
Dealers said the market would look to Wall Street for direction on Thursday, although a quarter percentage rise in interest rates was already discounted.
The overall index ended up 0.6 points to 7,079.5 points, the industrial index gained 11.9 points to 8,340.3 points and the gold index made 0.3 points to 1,326.0 points.
